name: Branch Assault
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components M, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect one tree
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You imbue one natural tree with the ability to attack creatures within its reach (10 feet). The tree is immobile and can attack only creatures under its branches. Once per round, the tree attacks at the caster’s base attack bonus and deals 2d6 points of bludgeoning damage with a successful hit.

The tree ceases its attacks if it receives more than 30 points of damage (hardness 4; AC 14).
